comment_text.value:
> I would wager Iran is barely hanging on. The question is which side can hang on longer.

I think this applies to both sides, and the issue is that the people in power are not affected by the crises that cause hardship to ordinary people. " Iran is..." does not distinguish between the two, they are different. Fanatical leadership can live by "Some of you may die, but it's a sacrifice I am willing to make" .

The problem though is that people in the USA do have one lever to pull on their government, in the form of approaching midterm elections, that the people of Iran do not. And the leadership of Iran knows it. They may be fanatical and awful but they're not stupid - causing fuel shortages causes economic pain to ordinary people causes political pain to the USA. They have this weapon and are using it heavily.

Notwithstanding that, this assessment of blame is correct ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49907371 ), the missteps that put us in this mess with no clear way out all come from stupid leadership in the USA.

story_title.value: September 2026: The world today, as seen by one Polish guy

That is a fun website design. My current strategy is to have a sub agent pretend to be a hackernews reader who hates AI slop. It then goes through the whole UI and removes all the slop.

It works really well, even with models like DeepSeek which have been completely poisoned with claudeslop. You get a website that actually makes sense, and doesn’t have random slop lines like “Logout— it stays logged in until the user logs out”

Now I guess I need to do a pass with a whimsy subagent to add fun little elements like this.

story_title.value: How our vibe coded website looks like a designer made it

You guys are playing it wrong. You don’t larpmax in general, you do it to hit specific targets.

The person who decides my promotions follows me on LinkedIn. I never really see her except at the Christmas party etc, so the only way to influence her directly is through getting in her feed. If she regularly sees how great I am, that establishes the thought in her mind, so when she is then asked to promote me by other people, she’ll think it’s a good idea.
